title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 651–700 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: Put your pens, pencils, and eraser into the pencil case.
examples.zh: 把你的原子筆、鉛筆和橡皮擦放進筆袋裡。

examples.en: She bought a stylish canvas pencil case for the new school semester.
examples.zh: 她為新學期買了一個時尚的帆布鉛筆盒。

examples.en: I forgot my pencil case at home and had to borrow a pen from a classmate.
examples.zh: 我把鉛筆盒忘在家裡，只好向同學借筆。

examples.en: Write the teacher's key points in your notebook.
examples.zh: 把老師講的重點記在筆記本上。

examples.en: She keeps a daily gratitude notebook on her bedside table.
examples.zh: 她在床頭櫃上放了一本日常感恩日記筆記本。

examples.en: He typed his project notes onto his portable slim notebook.
examples.zh: 他把專案筆記輸入到輕薄便攜的筆記型電腦中。

examples.en: Open your English textbook to page twenty.
examples.zh: 把你的英文課本翻到第二十頁。

examples.en: High school students carry heavy textbooks in their backpacks.
examples.zh: 高中生在書包裡背著沉重的教科書。

examples.en: The science textbook explains photosynthesis with clear colorful diagrams.
examples.zh: 這本自然科學教科書用清晰的彩色圖表解釋光合作用。

examples.en: Complete exercise A and B in your workbook.
examples.zh: 完成習作本上的練習題 A 和 B。

examples.en: Our math teacher checks our workbook homework every morning.
examples.zh: 我們的數學老師每天早晨都會批改習作本作業。

examples.en: Practicing exercises in the grammar workbook boosts test scores.
examples.zh: 在文法習作本上多做練習能有效提升考試成績。

examples.en: Look up new vocabulary words in the online dictionary.
examples.zh: 在線上字典中查詢生字。

examples.en: A bilingual English-Chinese dictionary is essential for language learners.
examples.zh: 英漢雙語字典對語言學習者來說是不可或缺的。

examples.en: She consults the dictionary to verify accurate word pronunciations.
examples.zh: 她查閱字典以確認單字的精確發音。

examples.en: The teacher used a red marker on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 老師在白板上使用了紅色白板筆。

examples.en: Highlight important exam definitions with a bright yellow marker.
examples.zh: 用亮黃色螢光筆畫出重要的考試名詞定義。

examples.en: Make sure to cap the marker tightly so the ink won't dry out.
examples.zh: 務必把彩色筆蓋緊，以免墨水乾涸。

examples.en: Use a pair of scissors to cut out the picture.
examples.zh: 用剪刀把這張圖片剪下來。

examples.en: Children should use safety scissors with rounded tips for craft class.
examples.zh: 兒童在美勞課上應該使用圓頭安全剪刀。

examples.en: Be careful when passing scissors; hand them handle-first.
examples.zh: 遞剪刀時要當心，握住刀刃把刀柄朝向對方遞出。

examples.en: Glue the photo firmly onto the colored cardboard.
examples.zh: 把照片牢固地黏在彩色西卡紙上。

examples.en: A glue stick is much cleaner to use than messy liquid glue.
examples.zh: 固體口紅膠比黏膩的液態膠水用起來乾淨許多。

examples.en: Apply a small drop of super glue to fix the broken mug handle.
examples.zh: 滴一小滴快乾膠以修復破損的馬克杯把手。

examples.en: Stick the poster on the wall with clear tape.
examples.zh: 用透明膠帶把海報貼在牆上。

examples.en: We sealed the cardboard moving boxes tightly with brown packing tape.
examples.zh: 我們用棕色封箱膠帶將紙箱嚴密貼牢。

examples.en: The old cassette tape holds precious recordings of my grandfather singing.
examples.zh: 這盒老舊錄音帶保存著我祖父唱歌的珍貴錄音。

examples.en: Do you have a blank piece of paper for me?
examples.zh: 你有一張空白紙可以給我嗎？

examples.en: Please recycle waste paper to save trees and protect our planet.
examples.zh: 請回收廢紙以保護樹木與珍惜地球資源。

examples.en: The university professor published an influential academic research paper.
examples.zh: 那位大學教授發表了一篇具有影響力的學術研究論文。

examples.en: Turn to page fifty-five of the storybook.
examples.zh: 翻到故事書的第五十五頁。

examples.en: The web page failed to load properly due to a weak internet connection.
examples.zh: 由於網路連線不穩，該網頁無法正常載入。

examples.en: She bookmarked the final page before turning off the reading lamp.
examples.zh: 在關掉床頭閱讀燈前，她在最後一頁夾上了書籤。

examples.en: Please wait in line behind the yellow line.
examples.zh: 請在黃線後方依序排隊等候。

examples.en: Draw a straight line across the paper using a plastic ruler.
examples.zh: 用塑膠直尺在紙上畫出一條直線。

examples.en: Remember to rehearse your spoken lines before tomorrow's drama rehearsal.
examples.zh: 在明天的戲劇排練前，記得熟記你的台詞。

examples.en: Cut the apple into four equal slices.
examples.zh: 把蘋果切成四等份切片。

examples.en: He went to the barbershop on Saturday to get a neat hair cut.
examples.zh: 他週六去理髮店剪了一個俐落的髮型。

examples.en: The government announced plans to cut public transportation fares for seniors.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了調降長者大眾運輸票價的計劃。

examples.en: Copy the sentence and paste it into the document.
examples.zh: 複製這句話並將它貼到文件中。

examples.en: Mix flour and water together to create a smooth adhesive paste.
examples.zh: 將麵粉和水混合在一起，調製成滑順的黏稠漿糊。

examples.en: Tomato paste adds rich depth to traditional Italian pasta sauces.
examples.zh: 番茄糊為傳統義大利麵醬增添了濃郁的層次。

examples.en: Make a copy of this important certificate.
examples.zh: 把這份重要證書影印一份副本。

examples.en: Do not copy answers from your classmate during the quiz.
examples.zh: 隨堂測驗時不要抄襲同學的答案。

examples.en: The best-selling novel sold over one million copies worldwide.
examples.zh: 這本暢銷小說在全球銷售超過一百萬冊。

examples.en: Butterflies and bees are helpful insects.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶和蜜蜂是有益的昆蟲。

examples.en: Some harmless insects camouflage themselves to blend into tree bark.
examples.zh: 有些無害的昆蟲會偽裝自己以融入樹皮環境。

examples.en: Put on protective bug spray to repel biting insects during night walks.
examples.zh: 夜間散步時噴上防蚊液，以驅趕叮人的昆蟲。

examples.en: Ants work hard together to gather food for winter.
examples.zh: 螞蟻齊心協力儲存過冬糧食。

examples.en: A long trail of tiny black ants marched steadily across the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 一長串黑色小螞蟻整齊地列隊爬過廚房流理台。

examples.en: She is always as busy as an ant preparing for upcoming examinations.
examples.zh: 她總是像隻忙碌的小螞蟻一樣忙著準備即將到來的考試。

examples.en: Honey bees fly from flower to flower collecting nectar.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花叢間穿梭採集花蜜。

examples.en: Be careful not to disturb the beehive or bees might sting you.
examples.zh: 小心不要驚擾蜂窩，否則蜜蜂可能會蜇你。

examples.en: He has been a busy bee all morning cleaning every room.
examples.zh: 他整個早上就像隻勤勞的小蜜蜂一樣打掃每間房間。

examples.en: Taiwan is famously known as the Kingdom of Butterflies.
examples.zh: 台灣以「蝴蝶王國」的美譽聞名。

examples.en: A brightly colored butterfly landed gently on the blooming rose petal.
examples.zh: 一隻色彩鮮豔的蝴蝶輕盈地停在盛開的玫瑰花瓣上。

examples.en: Caterpillars transform miraculously into gorgeous winged butterflies.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲奇蹟般地蛻變為美麗的彩蝶。

examples.en: Apply mosquito repellent when hiking in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天去登山健行時請塗抹防蚊液。

examples.en: The annoying buzz of a mosquito kept me awake throughout the night.
examples.zh: 蚊子惱人的嗡嗡聲讓我整夜輾轉難眠。

examples.en: Stagnant standing water in flowerpots provides breeding grounds for mosquitoes.
examples.zh: 花盆底盤的死水積水會成為蚊子繁殖的溫床。

examples.en: The spider spun an intricate web in the garden corner.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛在花園角落織了一張精巧的網。

examples.en: Most house spiders are harmless and help catch troublesome flies.
examples.zh: 大多數居家蜘蛛是無害的，還能幫忙捕捉惱人的蒼蠅。

examples.en: She screamed in terror after spotting a large hairy spider on the bathroom wall.
examples.zh: 看見浴室牆上一隻毛茸茸的大蜘蛛後，她嚇得尖叫起來。

examples.en: Be cautious of poisonous snakes when walking in tall grass.
examples.zh: 走在高草叢中時要當心毒蛇。

examples.en: The winding mountain road snaked through the steep misty peaks.
examples.zh: 蜿蜒曲折的山路在陡峭雲霧繚繞的山峰間穿行。

examples.en: Snakes shed their skin several times a year as they grow larger.
examples.zh: 蛇在成長過程中每年都會蛻皮數次。

examples.en: Frogs croak loudly near the pond after rain.
examples.zh: 雨後池塘邊的青蛙呱呱大聲叫著。

examples.en: The green tree frog blended perfectly into the wet tropical leaves.
examples.zh: 綠色樹蛙完美融入了潮濕的熱帶樹葉之中。

examples.en: Tadpoles hatch from eggs in freshwater and gradually turn into frogs.
examples.zh: 蝌蚪在淡水卵中孵化，並逐漸長成青蛙。

examples.en: You can see green sea turtles snorkeling in Xiaoliuqiu.
examples.zh: 在小琉球浮潛可以看到綠蠵龜。

examples.en: The pet turtle crawled slowly across the sunny living room rug.
examples.zh: 寵物小烏龜在陽光明媚的客廳地毯上緩緩爬行。

examples.en: Marine conservation groups work tirelessly to protect endangered sea turtles.
examples.zh: 海洋保育團體不遺餘力地保護瀕臨滅絕的海龜。

examples.en: Tourists love watching the sheep shearing show at Cingjing Farm.
examples.zh: 遊客喜歡在清境農場觀看剪羊毛秀。

examples.en: A large flock of white sheep grazed peacefully on the green hillside pasture.
examples.zh: 一大群白綿羊在綠色山坡牧場上悠閒地吃草。

examples.en: If you struggle to fall asleep, try counting sheep in your mind.
examples.zh: 如果你輾轉難以入眠，試著在腦海中數綿羊吧。

examples.en: Mountain goats can climb extremely steep rocky cliffs.
examples.zh: 野山羊能夠攀爬非常陡峭的岩壁。

examples.en: Fresh goat milk and goat cheese are nutrient-rich dairy options.
examples.zh: 新鮮羊奶與羊乳酪是營養豐富的乳製品選擇。

examples.en: The lively baby goat leaped playfully around the farm enclosure.
examples.zh: 活潑的小山羊在農場圍欄周圍歡快地蹦蹦跳跳。

examples.en: Rabbits love munching on crisp carrots and lettuce.
examples.zh: 兔子喜歡啃食香脆的胡蘿蔔和生菜。

examples.en: The fluffy white rabbit hopped swiftly into its underground burrow.
examples.zh: 毛茸茸的白兔靈巧迅速地跳進了地下地洞。

examples.en: According to the Chinese zodiac, the Rabbit symbolizes gentleness and peace.
examples.zh: 在十二生肖中，兔象徵著溫和與和平。

words.definition: 老鼠；電腦滑鼠（複數 mice）

examples.en: Double-click the left mouse button to open the file.
examples.zh: 按兩下滑鼠左鍵以開啟檔案。

examples.en: An ergonomic wireless computer mouse reduces wrist fatigue.
examples.zh: 符合人體工學的無線電腦滑鼠能減輕手腕疲勞。

examples.en: The tiny brown field mouse scurried quickly under the wooden barn door.
examples.zh: 嬌小的棕色田鼠迅速溜進了木製穀倉門底下。

examples.en: Keep food sealed so rats won't get inside.
examples.zh: 把食物密封好，老鼠才不會跑進來。

examples.en: City sanitation teams set bait traps to control the rat population in sewers.
examples.zh: 城市環境衛生小組設置餌劑陷阱，以控制下水道的大老鼠數量。

examples.en: Rats are remarkably intelligent creatures capable of navigating intricate mazes.
examples.zh: 大老鼠是非常聰明的生物，能夠走出複雜的迷宮。

examples.en: Children love visiting the giant pandas at Taipei Zoo.
examples.zh: 小朋友們喜歡去台北市立動物園看大貓熊。

examples.en: Modern zoos prioritize animal welfare, habitat conservation, and public education.
examples.zh: 現代化動物園優先重視動物福祉、棲地保育與大眾教育。

examples.en: We spent an enjoyable Saturday afternoon exploring the open-air safari zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在戶外野生動物園度過了一個愉快的週六下午。

examples.en: Keelung is located in the north of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 基隆位於台灣北部。

examples.en: Migratory birds fly north when warm spring weather arrives.
examples.zh: 候鳥在溫暖春日來臨時往北飛翔。

examples.en: The compass needle always points steadily toward magnetic north.
examples.zh: 指南針的指針始終穩定指向地磁北方。

examples.en: Kenting is in the south, known for sunny beaches.
examples.zh: 墾丁在南部，以陽光明媚的海灘聞名。

examples.en: Many elderly people travel south during winter to escape frigid weather.
examples.zh: 許多長者在冬天前往南方避寒。

examples.en: Kaohsiung is Taiwan's largest port city located in the sunny south.
examples.zh: 高雄是位於陽光明媚南部的台灣第一大港口城市。

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean lies to the east of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 太平洋位於台灣的東方。

examples.en: Early risers gather at Sanxiantai on the east coast to watch the sunrise.
examples.zh: 早起的人們齊聚在東海岸的三仙台觀賞日出。

examples.en: The morning sun rises reliably in the east every new dawn.
examples.zh: 晨曦的太陽在每個黎明準時從東方升起。

examples.en: The sun sets in the west over the ocean.
examples.zh: 太陽在西方海面上緩緩落下。

examples.en: Taiwan's major high-speed rail line runs along the flat west coast plain.
examples.zh: 台灣的高鐵主幹線沿著平坦的西海岸平原運行。

examples.en: We drove west toward the coastal scenic highway to catch the twilight.
examples.zh: 我們開車一路向西前往濱海景觀公路追逐餘暉。

examples.en: Taichung is situated in central western Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台中位於台灣中西部。

examples.en: The modern civic sports center offers swimming pools and fitness gyms.
examples.zh: 這座現代化的國民運動中心提供游泳池與健身房。

examples.en: Place the birthday cake right in the center of the dining table.
examples.zh: 把生日蛋糕端正地擺放在餐桌正中央。

examples.en: The bank is in the middle of the shopping street.
examples.zh: 銀行就在這條商店街的中間位置。

examples.en: She woke up suddenly in the middle of the night hearing rain.
examples.zh: 她在半夜聽見雨聲時突然驚醒。

examples.en: Sit in the middle seat so you can talk easily with everyone.
examples.zh: 坐在中間座位，這樣你能輕鬆跟每個人交談。

examples.en: We reached the top of the mountain at noon.
examples.zh: 我們在中午抵達了山頂。

examples.en: She ranked at the very top of her graduating high school class.
examples.zh: 她在高中畢業班中名列前茅、榮登榜首。

examples.en: Put the heavy storage boxes at the bottom and lighter ones on top.
examples.zh: 把沉重的收納箱放在底部，較輕的放在頂層。

examples.en: Sign your full name at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 在頁面底部簽上你的全名。

examples.en: Colorful sea coral thrives at the bottom of the shallow reef.
examples.zh: 色彩繽紛的珊瑚在淺礁底部茂盛生長。

examples.en: The bottom line of business negotiation is reaching mutual profitability.
examples.zh: 商業談判的底線是達成互利雙贏。

examples.en: Please walk on the sidewalk to stay safe.
examples.zh: 請走在人行道側邊以確保安全。

examples.en: Flip the fried egg over to brown the other side evenly.
examples.zh: 把荷包蛋翻面，使另一面也均勻煎成金黃色。

examples.en: True friends will stand by your side through joyful and challenging moments.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友會在歡樂與困難的時刻陪伴在你身邊。

examples.en: It is raining heavily outside; don't go out.
examples.zh: 外面正下著傾盆大雨，別出門。

examples.en: Please wait outside the doctor's office until your number is called.
examples.zh: 請在診間外面等候叫號。

examples.en: The crisp outer crust of freshly baked French bread is delicious.
examples.zh: 現烤法國麵包酥脆的外層表皮非常美味。

examples.en: Come inside and warm up with some hot tea.
examples.zh: 快進來喝點熱茶暖暖身子。

examples.en: What treasures are stored inside that mysterious wooden locked chest?
examples.zh: 那口神秘上鎖的木箱裡究竟存放了什麼寶物？

examples.en: He turned his jacket inside out to let the damp lining dry.
examples.zh: 他把夾克翻過來讓潮濕的內裡晾乾。

examples.en: The airplane flew high above the clouds.
examples.zh: 飛機在高高雲層上方飛行。

examples.en: Temperatures in southern Taiwan frequently rise above thirty degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 南台灣的氣溫經常飆升至攝氏三十度以上。

examples.en: Please read the terms and conditions outlined above before signing.
examples.zh: 簽名之前，請詳閱上方列出的各項條款。

examples.en: The temperature dropped below ten degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 氣溫下降到了攝氏十度以下。

examples.en: Divers marvel at the rich variety of marine life swimming below them.
examples.zh: 潛水員驚嘆於在他們下方遊動的豐富海洋生物。

examples.en: Please check the detailed schedule listed in the table below.
examples.zh: 請參閱下方表格中所列出的詳細時程表。

examples.en: Don't be afraid of making mistakes in English.
examples.zh: 不要害怕說英語時犯錯。

examples.en: The little girl is afraid of thunder and hides under blankets.
examples.zh: 小女孩害怕雷聲，會躲進被窩裡。

examples.en: I am afraid we have run completely out of stock on that item.
examples.zh: 恐怕那款商品我們已經全數售罄缺貨了。

examples.en: The little boy was brave when getting a vaccination.
examples.zh: 小男孩打預防針時非常勇敢。

examples.en: Firefighters are remarkably brave heroes who risk life to save others.
examples.zh: 消防員是冒生命危險拯救他人的無比英勇英雄。

examples.en: It takes brave determination to admit fault and apologize sincerely.
examples.zh: 承認錯誤並誠懇道歉需要無比的勇氣與決心。

examples.en: Students are excited about the upcoming school field trip.
examples.zh: 學生們對即將到來的校外教學感到很興奮。

examples.en: She felt thrilled and excited when her visa was approved.
examples.zh: 當簽證獲准時，她感到無比激動與興奮雀躍。

examples.en: Fans waited excitedly outside the airport terminal to greet their idol.
examples.zh: 粉絲們興奮地在機場航廈外等候迎接偶像。

examples.en: Riding the rollercoaster was an exciting adventure.
examples.zh: 坐雲霄飛車是一場刺激的冒險。

examples.en: The championship soccer final was one of the most exciting games this year.
examples.zh: 這場足球冠軍決賽是今年最扣人心弦的比賽之一。

examples.en: Moving to a vibrant new city presents exciting career opportunities.
examples.zh: 搬到充滿活力的新城市會帶來令人振奮的職涯機會。

examples.en: That long speech was so boring that I fell asleep.
examples.zh: 那場冗長的演講太無聊了，以至於我睡著了。

examples.en: Doing repetitive data entry tasks all day can become quite boring.
examples.zh: 整天做重複性的資料輸入工作可能會變得相當枯燥乏味。

examples.en: Waiting in an endless airport delay line is thoroughly boring.
examples.zh: 在無休止的機場航班延誤隊伍中等候極其無聊。

examples.en: He felt bored staying home all day on a rainy day.
examples.zh: 雨天整天待在家裡讓他感到很無聊。

examples.en: Children quickly get bored during lengthy adult social gatherings.
examples.zh: 在冗長的大人社交聚會中小孩很快就會感到厭倦無聊。

examples.en: If you ever feel bored, pick up an engaging novel to read.
examples.zh: 如果你感到無聊，不妨拿一本引人入勝的小說來讀。

examples.en: Science experiments are both fun and interesting.
examples.zh: 自然科學實驗既好玩又很有趣。

examples.en: He shared an interesting story about his adventurous backpacking trip.
examples.zh: 他分享了一段關於他充滿冒險的背包旅行趣事。

examples.en: The historical documentary revealed fascinating and interesting facts about our ancestors.
examples.zh: 這部歷史紀錄片揭露了關於我們祖先許多引人入勝的有趣事實。
